46: And rabbi meir that says... - This means to say for Rabbi Yehuda that says in Bava Kamma: which one (is) warned? All that (has) testimony upon him three (different) days, there is to say here three years is similar to three days. But for rabbi meir that says, the innocent (bull), even if (he) gored three times in one day becomes 'warned', a priori here (where) he also ate three fruits in one day; for example, fig that (does) not mature together (at the same time), and there are (some that) aren't mature in the morning and by evening they are proper (mature), here too it should be chazaka! (The gemara) answers: similar to the warned bull... (for example the figs already existed but were not proper yet while the additional gorings do not exist at all)
